description:
## Finding

`EvaluationReport` at `pkix-lint/src/report.rs:55` derives `PartialEq` but not `Eq`. Clippy flags this with `clippy::derive_partial_eq_without_eq`. All fields are themselves `Eq`, so deriving `Eq` is sound and gives consumers access to `Hash` derivation, `BTreeSet`/`HashSet` storage, etc.

## Location

```
pkix-lint/src/report.rs:55-56

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq)]
pub struct EvaluationReport {
```

## Fix

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct EvaluationReport {
```

## Priority

P3 — small, idiomatic, observable to consumers in a way that matters (Hash, set keys).
title: P3: EvaluationReport derives PartialEq but not Eq
